job.title: Senior Data Engineer (80-100%)
job.description:
## Your tasks
- Design and operate batch and streaming pipelines on Databricks and Spark
- Model curated data products with dbt on Snowflake
- Orchestrate workloads with Airflow on Azure

## Your profile
- 6+ years as a data engineer, ideally in banking or another regulated industry
- Expert SQL and Python, strong data modeling skills
- Fluent English; German is not required
- Valid Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship required

## What we offer
Hybrid work (2 days in the office), 27 days of vacation.

features.rationale: Senior DE in Zurich bank, English only, work permit clause satisfied by EU citizenship, strong stack overlap.
